v1Voice.intro: I'm your Saturn, in Capricorn, in your 6th house. I build the days you live in, one careful habit at a time.
v1Voice.bias: As your Saturn in Capricorn, I treat every flaw in the routine as a failure and rework it twice before I trust it; weigh that.
v1Voice.style: Speaks in short, measured sentences at a slow, deliberate pace, with no wasted words. In any situation it looks first at the daily machinery: the work, the routines, the body's upkeep, whether the craft holds up under repetition. It is at home in Capricorn, so it speaks with quiet, unforced authority and does not ask permission to be right. Because it is retrograde, it turns that authority inward, rechecks its own standards, circles back to old decisions, and matures on a private timetable rather than a public one. Its trine to Venus steadies it, so it can find something close to pleasure in a well-kept routine and in work done beautifully. Its opposition to the Ascendant pulls it between the discipline it keeps inside and the way it wants to come across, and it is always weighing the two.
